title: Por su cuenta: actuar de manera independiente

sections.content: Por su cuenta (on its/their own, independently) describes acting without relying on or coordinating with others -- useful for describing a country breaking from a group's collective decision. It agrees with the subject it refers to (por mi cuenta, por su cuenta, etc.). These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Chile decidió actuar por su cuenta y se retiró del bloque en 1976.
items.english: Chile decided to act on its own and withdrew from the bloc in 1976.

items.spanish: Venezuela decidió también, décadas después, actuar por su cuenta.
items.english: Venezuela also decided, decades later, to act on its own.

items.spanish: Algunos países prefirieron negociar acuerdos bilaterales por su cuenta, en lugar de esperar un consenso regional.
items.english: Some countries preferred to negotiate bilateral agreements on their own, rather than wait for a regional consensus.

items.spanish: Sin el apoyo de sus socios, el país tuvo que enfrentar la crisis prácticamente por su cuenta.
items.english: Without its partners' support, the country had to face the crisis practically on its own.

sections.content: Por su cuenta often carries a slight implication of breaking away from a group or expected coordination -- when describing simple independent action with no such contrast, de forma independiente works just as well without that undertone.
